note: Topic map for Ask Bible Advisor. 'keywords' are matched against the question (single words also match simple plurals and -ing/-ed forms; phrases match as written). Verses are references only; the app shows the exact bundled text. Reflections were written for this app and are not Scripture.

topics.title: Forgiving others
topics.summary: God forgives us, and He asks us to forgive others too.

verses.reflection: Jesus ties our forgiveness of others to the way we receive God's forgiveness. Forgiving is part of living in God's mercy.
Peter wanted a limit on forgiveness. Jesus answered that forgiveness keeps going.
Jesus calls us to stop judging and condemning, and to forgive. Mercy given is mercy received.
We forgive because God first forgave us in Christ. Kindness and a tender heart make forgiveness possible.
Forgiving is not saying the wrong did not matter. It is choosing to release it, just as Christ released us.

topics.title: Guilt and being forgiven
topics.summary: In Jesus, God offers full forgiveness to everyone who comes to Him.

verses.reflection: Jesus did not condemn the woman brought to Him. He forgave her and called her to a new life.
Confession is simply telling God the truth. He is faithful to forgive and cleanse.
For those who belong to Christ Jesus, there is no condemnation left.
God removes forgiven sin as far as the east is from the west, a distance that never ends.
No stain is too deep for God to wash white as snow.

topics.title: Marriage
topics.summary: God designed marriage as a lifelong union of love, faithfulness and self-giving.

verses.reflection: Jesus says marriage is something God joins together. That makes it worth protecting.
From the beginning, God's plan was for a husband and wife to leave, hold fast, and become one.
The model for loving a spouse is Christ, who gave Himself for His people.
This picture of love is patient, kind, and enduring. It is a daily guide for any marriage.
Two are better than one, because each can lift the other up when they fall.

topics.title: Family
topics.summary: God cares about families and calls us to honor, love and serve one another at home.

verses.reflection: Honoring your father and mother is one of the Ten Commandments, and it comes with a promise.
Joshua decided that his whole household would serve the Lord. Every family can make that choice.
Unity in a family is good and pleasant, like a gift from God.
God's way for children is to obey and honor their parents in the Lord.
Caring for your own family is a real part of living out your faith.

topics.title: Raising children
topics.summary: Children are a gift from God, and parents are called to raise them gently in His ways.

verses.reflection: Jesus welcomed children and was upset when people tried to keep them away from Him.
Children are a heritage and a gift from the Lord.
The ways we teach children when they are young shape the path they walk later.
Faith is passed on in everyday moments: sitting at home, walking, lying down, and getting up.
Parents are asked not to provoke their children to anger, but to bring them up in the Lord's care and teaching.

topics.title: Work and jobs
topics.summary: Work can be done for the Lord, with diligence and trust.

verses.reflection: Whatever your job, you can do it with all your heart as service to the Lord.
Bring your work and plans to the Lord, and He will establish them.
It is right to ask God to bless and establish the work of your hands.
Real work brings profit, while only talking about it leads to need.
Whatever you do, do it with all your strength while you have the chance.

topics.title: Fear
topics.summary: God is with you, so fear does not have to rule you.

verses.reflection: In the storm, Jesus says, "It is I; be not afraid." His presence is the answer to fear.
God promises His presence, His strength, and His help to those who are afraid.
When the Lord is your light and salvation, fear loses its grip.
God gives power, love, and a sound mind, not a spirit of fear.
When fear comes, you can choose to trust God right then.

topics.title: Worry and anxiety
topics.summary: Bring every worry to God in prayer and receive His peace.

verses.reflection: Jesus invites you to live today with Him and leave tomorrow in the Father's hands.
Turn every worry into a prayer with thanks, and God's peace will guard your heart and mind.
You can give all your cares to God, because He cares for you.
Perfect peace comes to the mind that stays on God.
When your thoughts are many, God's comfort can bring joy to your soul.

topics.title: Being saved
topics.summary: Salvation is God's free gift through faith in Jesus Christ.

verses.reflection: God loved the world so much that He gave His Son, so that whoever believes in Him has eternal life.
Jesus says that whoever hears His word and believes has already passed from death to life.
Sin earns death, but God offers eternal life as a free gift through Jesus Christ.
You cannot earn salvation. It is God's gift, received by faith.
Salvation is found in no other name than Jesus.

topics.title: Prayer
topics.summary: Prayer is talking with your Father, who hears you.

verses.reflection: Jesus gave us a pattern for prayer: honor God, seek His will, ask for daily needs, forgiveness, and protection.
Prayer does not need an audience. Your Father sees and hears you in secret.
Jesus taught that we should always pray and not give up.
When you do not know what to pray, the Holy Spirit helps you.
When we ask according to God's will, we can be confident that He hears us.

topics.title: Death and dying
topics.summary: Jesus is the resurrection and the life. Death is not the end for those who trust Him.

verses.reflection: Jesus promises that those who believe in Him will live, even though they die.
Jesus is preparing a place for His people, and He will bring them to be with Him.
Goodness and mercy follow God's people all their days, and they will dwell in His house forever.
For Paul, living meant Christ, and dying meant gaining even more of Him.
Jesus became human to break the power of death and free people from the fear of it.

topics.title: Money and provision
topics.summary: God knows your needs. Trust Him, work wisely, and seek His kingdom first.

verses.reflection: Put God's kingdom first, and trust Him with your needs.
Your life is worth far more than what you own.
God promises to supply the needs of His people.
Contentment grows from knowing God will never leave you.
Debt has a cost. God's wisdom invites careful choices with borrowing.

topics.title: Purpose and meaning
topics.summary: God made you on purpose and for a purpose: to know Him, love Him and do good.
keywords: what should i do with my life

verses.reflection: Jesus summed up life's purpose: love God with everything, and love your neighbor as yourself.
Your good works can shine so others see them and give glory to God.
You are God's workmanship, created in Christ for good works He prepared for you.
God knew Jeremiah before he was born and had a purpose for him. God knows you too.
After searching everything, the Teacher concluded: honor God and keep His commands.

topics.title: Anger
topics.summary: Bring anger to God before it turns into sin.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls us to love and pray for those who wrong us. He gives the strength to do it.
Be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger.
Anger can be felt without sinning, but it should be dealt with quickly.
A gentle answer can turn anger away.
Ruling your own spirit takes more strength than conquering a city.

topics.title: Temptation
topics.summary: God always provides a way out, and Jesus understands temptation.

verses.reflection: Jesus tells us to watch and pray, because the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.
God is faithful and will always provide a way out. Look for it.
Jesus was tempted in every way, yet without sin. Come to Him for help.
Submit to God and resist the devil, and he will flee.
Storing God's Word in your heart helps you not to sin.

topics.title: Sickness and healing
topics.summary: Jesus cares for the sick. Bring your body and your pain to Him.

verses.reflection: Jesus stopped for a sick woman, called her "Daughter," and gave her peace.
Jesus went from place to place healing all kinds of sickness.
When sick, ask God's people to pray for you.
"Heal me, O Lord" is a prayer God welcomes.
Even as the body weakens, God can renew the inner person day by day.

topics.title: Patience
topics.summary: God grows patience in us as we wait on Him.

verses.reflection: Waiting on the Lord takes courage, and He strengthens your heart.
Rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep praying.
Like a farmer waiting for rain and harvest, be patient and steady your heart.
Do not give up doing good. The harvest comes in due time.
A patient spirit is better than a proud one.

topics.title: Loving others
topics.summary: We love because God first loved us.

verses.reflection: Jesus gave a new command: love one another as He has loved you.
Love comes from God, because God is love.
Our love is a response to the love God showed us first.
Faith, hope, and love remain, and the greatest is love.
Real love shows itself in actions, not only words.

topics.title: Does God love me?
topics.summary: Yes. God's love for you is everlasting and shown most clearly in Jesus.

verses.reflection: Jesus loves you the way the Father loves Him, and invites you to remain in that love.
God showed His love by Christ dying for us while we were still sinners.
God's love is everlasting. He draws His people with kindness.
God loves you so much that He calls you His child.
Nothing in all creation can separate you from God's love in Christ Jesus.

topics.title: Loneliness
topics.summary: Even when you feel alone, God is with you.

verses.reflection: Jesus promises He is with you always, to the end of the age.
The Lord goes before you and will never leave you.
God places lonely people in families. Ask Him to lead you to His people.
God will never forget you. Your name is written on His hands.
Jesus will not leave His followers as orphans.

topics.title: Grief and loss
topics.summary: Jesus weeps with you and gives a real hope beyond death.

verses.reflection: Jesus wept at His friend's grave. He knows grief, and He shares yours.
Those who mourn are blessed, because God will comfort them.
God is near to the brokenhearted.
Christians grieve, but with hope, because Jesus died and rose again.
God will wipe away every tear. Death and sorrow will be gone.

topics.title: Feeling low
topics.summary: God meets us in the pit and lifts us up. It is also wise to ask for help from people and doctors.

verses.reflection: Jesus invites the weary and heavy-laden to come to Him for rest.
The psalmist talks honestly to his downcast soul and tells it to hope in God.
God heard David's cry, lifted him from the pit, and put a new song in his mouth.
When Elijah was exhausted and wanted to give up, God let him sleep and sent food. God cares for the whole person.
The Lord is a shield around you and the one who lifts your head.

topics.title: When life feels hopeless
topics.summary: Your life is precious to God. Please reach out for help right now.

verses.reflection: Jesus came to give life, full and abundant. The voice that says to destroy is not His.
God is close to you when your heart is broken and your spirit is crushed.
God made you with care. You are fearfully and wonderfully made.
In a very dark time, the writer remembered God's mercy and found hope again.
God will not break a bruised reed or put out a flickering flame. He is gentle with the weak.

topics.title: Doubt and faith
topics.summary: Honest doubts are welcome. Jesus meets doubters with kindness.

verses.reflection: Jesus came to doubting Thomas and invited him to see and believe.
"I believe; help my unbelief" is an honest prayer Jesus answered.
Jesus promises that seekers find.
The faith rests on real events: Christ died, was buried, and rose again.
Faith grows by hearing God's Word.

topics.title: Wisdom and decisions
topics.summary: Ask God for wisdom, search His Word, and seek wise counsel.

verses.reflection: If you lack wisdom, ask God. He gives generously.
Trust God fully rather than leaning only on your own understanding, and He will direct your paths.
There is safety in many counselors. Talk big decisions over with wise believers.
True wisdom begins with reverence for the Lord.
God's wisdom is pure, peaceful, gentle, and full of mercy. Use this to test your choices.

topics.title: Friendship
topics.summary: Good friends sharpen and support each other. Jesus calls His followers friends.

verses.reflection: Jesus showed the greatest love: laying down His life for His friends.
A true friend loves at all times, especially in hard times.
Good friends make each other better, like iron sharpening iron.
The people you walk with shape who you become.
There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

topics.title: Pride and humility
topics.summary: God lifts up the humble. Jesus is our example.

verses.reflection: Jesus taught that those who humble themselves will be lifted up.
Jesus, though He was God, humbled Himself and served, even to death on a cross.
Humble yourself before the Lord, and He will lift you up.
Pride comes before a fall.
Humility looks out for the interests of others, not only your own.

topics.title: Jealousy and envy
topics.summary: Envy rots the heart. Contentment and love set it free.

verses.reflection: A peaceful heart brings life, but envy eats away at you.
Love does not envy. Ask God to fill you with His love.
Comparison leads to envy and competition. God's people are called to something better.
Where envy and selfish ambition grow, disorder follows.
Do not envy people who do wrong. What they have will not last.

topics.title: Sexual purity
topics.summary: God made our bodies good and calls us to honor Him with them.

verses.reflection: Jesus blesses the pure in heart: they will see God.
Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, bought at a price. Honor God with it.
A young person keeps their way pure by living by God's Word.
Job made a promise with his eyes. Guarding what you look at guards your heart.
God honors marriage and asks us to keep the marriage bed pure.

topics.title: Addiction and freedom
topics.summary: Jesus sets people free. Freedom often comes step by step, with help from others.

verses.reflection: Jesus promises that if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
Christ set us free. Stand firm and do not go back under slavery.
Paul refused to be mastered by anything. Only God should be your master.
God always provides a way of escape. Plan ahead for it, and ask others to help you.
God's grace not only saves; it trains us to say no to what harms us.

topics.title: Hope
topics.summary: Hope in God is sure, because it rests on Jesus who rose from the dead.

verses.reflection: Jesus came to give life in full.
God told His people His thoughts toward them were of peace and a future.
The God of hope fills believers with joy and peace.
Hope in Christ is an anchor for the soul.
Because Jesus rose, we have a living hope.

topics.title: Peace
topics.summary: Jesus gives a peace the world cannot give.

verses.reflection: Jesus leaves His own peace with His followers.
Through faith in Jesus, we have peace with God.
God keeps in perfect peace the mind that trusts in Him.
Let the peace of Christ rule in your heart.
This ancient blessing asks God to keep you, shine on you, and give you peace.

topics.title: Joy
topics.summary: Joy is found in God's presence and grows from knowing Jesus.

verses.reflection: Jesus wants His joy to be in you and your joy to be full.
In God's presence there is fullness of joy.
Rejoice in the Lord always.
The joy of the Lord is your strength.
The birth of Jesus is good news of great joy for all people.

topics.title: Thankfulness
topics.summary: Giving thanks turns our hearts back to the Giver of every good gift.

verses.reflection: Jesus noticed the one healed man who came back to thank God.
Give thanks in every circumstance.
Give thanks, for God is good and His mercy lasts forever.
Every good gift comes from the Father above.
Come into God's presence with thanksgiving.

topics.title: Strength in weakness
topics.summary: God's strength is made perfect in our weakness.

verses.reflection: The Lord told Paul His grace is enough, and His power is perfected in weakness.
God gives power to the faint.
Christ strengthens His people for whatever they face.
The Lord is a rock, a fortress, and a deliverer.
Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

topics.title: Trusting God
topics.summary: God is faithful. You can trust Him with your life.

verses.reflection: Trust God with all your heart, and He will make your paths straight.
Commit your way to the Lord and trust Him.
When afraid, choose to trust God and His Word.
God has never forsaken those who seek Him.
Some trust in power and things; we trust in the name of the Lord.

topics.title: Obeying God
topics.summary: Love for Jesus shows itself in doing what He says.

verses.reflection: Jesus said that those who love Him will keep His commands.
Those who hear God's Word and keep it are blessed.
Obeying Jesus keeps us close to His love.
Do not only listen to the Word. Do what it says.
God values a listening, obedient heart more than outward religious acts.

topics.title: Suffering and trials
topics.summary: God is with His people in suffering and uses even trials for good.

verses.reflection: Jesus said we would have trouble, but He has overcome the world.
Present sufferings are small compared to the glory to come.
Trials test our faith and grow endurance that makes us mature.
Our troubles are light and short compared to eternal glory. Fix your eyes on what is unseen.
God's people face many troubles, but the Lord delivers them.

topics.title: Mocked for your faith
topics.summary: Jesus said His followers would face opposition, and He blesses them in it.

verses.reflection: Jesus blesses those persecuted for His sake. Great is their reward in heaven.
If the world hates you, remember it hated Jesus first.
If you suffer for doing right, you are blessed. Do not be afraid.
Nothing can separate us from Christ's love. In Him we are more than conquerors.
The apostles rejoiced to be counted worthy to suffer for Jesus' name.

topics.title: Enemies
topics.summary: Jesus calls us to love our enemies and leave justice to God.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls His followers to love their enemies and pray for them, like children of their Father.
Love enemies and do good expecting nothing back. That is how God treats people.
Answer an enemy's need with kindness.
When your ways please the Lord, He can bring peace even with enemies.
God cares for His people even in the presence of their enemies.

topics.title: Words and gossip
topics.summary: Words have power to give life or to hurt. Use them to build up.

verses.reflection: Jesus says our words matter, even careless ones.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue.
Let only words that build others up come out of your mouth.
Kind words are sweet like honey and healing to the body.
Ask God to guard your mouth.

topics.title: Honesty and lying
topics.summary: God delights in truth. Jesus is the truth that sets us free.

verses.reflection: Jesus said that knowing the truth sets you free.
God delights in people who are truthful.
Put away lying and speak truth, because we belong to each other.
Lying belongs to the old life. In Christ we put on the new self.
A person of integrity walks safely.

topics.title: Generosity
topics.summary: God loves a cheerful giver, and Jesus said it is more blessed to give.

verses.reflection: Jesus said it is more blessed to give than to receive.
Give freely from the heart, not under pressure. God loves a cheerful giver.
Jesus teaches that generosity comes back in good measure.
Give quietly. Your Father sees what is done in secret.
Kindness to the poor is like lending to the Lord.

topics.title: The Holy Spirit
topics.summary: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit to be with His people, to help, teach and change them.

verses.reflection: Jesus promised another Helper, the Spirit of truth, to be with His people forever.
The Holy Spirit gives power to be witnesses for Jesus.
The Spirit grows love, joy, peace, and more in believers.
The Spirit helps us when we are weak and do not know how to pray.
God promised a new heart and His Spirit within His people.

topics.title: Who is Jesus?
topics.summary: Jesus is the Word made flesh, the Son of God, and the Savior of the world.

verses.reflection: Before anything was made, the Word already was. The Word was with God and was God.
The Word became flesh and lived among us. This is Jesus.
Jesus asks everyone the same question: "Who do you say that I am?"
Jesus is the Good Shepherd who gives His life for the sheep.
Jesus is the image of the invisible God. All things were made by Him and for Him.

topics.title: Grace
topics.summary: Grace is God's undeserved kindness, given freely in Jesus.

verses.reflection: Grace and truth came through Jesus Christ, and from Him we receive grace upon grace.
God, rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ. By grace we are saved.
God saved us because of His mercy, not because of our good deeds.
Come boldly to the throne of grace for help when you need it.
Where sin grew, grace grew even more.

topics.title: Self-worth and identity
topics.summary: You are made in God's image and loved by Him. In Christ you are His child.

verses.reflection: God knows when a sparrow falls and has numbered the hairs on your head. Jesus says you are worth more than many sparrows.
Every person is made in the image of God.
You are fearfully and wonderfully made.
People look at outward appearance, but God looks at the heart.
In Christ you are chosen, royal, holy, and God's own.

topics.title: The future
topics.summary: You do not know tomorrow, but you can know the One who holds it.

verses.reflection: Jesus tells us not to worry about tomorrow. Live today with Him.
God's thoughts toward His people are of peace and a future.
We make plans, but the Lord directs our steps.
Hold your plans humbly and say, "If the Lord wills."
God will finish the good work He started in you.

topics.title: Courage
topics.summary: Be strong and courageous, because the Lord goes with you.

verses.reflection: Be strong and courageous, for God is with you wherever you go.
The Lord goes with you and will never leave you.
God holds your right hand and says, "Fear not; I will help you."
Stay alert, stand firm in the faith, and be strong.
The early church prayed for boldness to speak God's Word.

topics.title: Justice
topics.summary: God loves justice and calls His people to do right and care for the weak.

verses.reflection: God asks us to do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him.
Learn to do good, seek justice, and defend the weak.
Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves.
God wants justice to flow like a river that never runs dry.
The Lord loves justice and does not abandon His people.

topics.title: Serving others
topics.summary: Jesus came to serve, and He calls His followers to serve one another.

verses.reflection: Jesus came not to be served, but to serve and give His life.
Jesus washed His friends' feet to show us how to serve.
Whatever you do for the least of these, you do for Jesus.
Use the gifts God has given you to serve others.
Use your freedom to serve one another in love.

topics.title: Church and fellowship
topics.summary: Following Jesus is meant to be done together with other believers.

verses.reflection: Where two or three gather in Jesus' name, He is there with them.
Keep meeting together and encourage one another.
The first believers shared meals, worship, and joy together.
Together, believers are the body of Christ, and each one has a part.
We are many members of one body, and we belong to each other.

topics.title: The Bible
topics.summary: God's Word is living, true and lasting. It leads us to Jesus.

verses.reflection: Jesus said heaven and earth will pass away, but His words never will.
All Scripture is inspired by God and equips us for every good work.
God's Word is living and active. It speaks to the heart.
God's Word lights the way ahead.
The person who delights in God's Word is like a tree planted by water.

topics.title: Worship and praise
topics.summary: God is worthy of worship with our songs, our words and our whole lives.

verses.reflection: The Father seeks people who worship Him in spirit and in truth.
Come, bow down and worship the Lord our Maker.
Offering your whole life to God is true worship.
Through Jesus, offer God a constant sacrifice of praise.
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.

topics.title: Heaven and eternal life
topics.summary: Eternal life is knowing God through Jesus, now and forever.

verses.reflection: Jesus defined eternal life as knowing the true God and Jesus Christ whom He sent.
Jesus is preparing a place for His people.
God will live with His people and wipe away every tear.
No eye has seen what God has prepared for those who love Him.
Believers are citizens of heaven, waiting for the Savior.

topics.title: Young people
topics.summary: God has a purpose for young people. You can set an example now.

verses.reflection: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young. Set an example.
Remember your Creator while you are young.
A young person stays on a pure path by following God's Word.
Run from what harms you, and follow what is good with friends who love God.
Listen to the wise teaching of your parents.

topics.title: Growing older
topics.summary: God carries His people through every season, even into old age.

verses.reflection: God promises to carry His people even to old age and gray hair.
God's people can still bear fruit in old age.
Older believers can tell the next generation about God's power.
Gray hair is a crown of glory when it is found in a righteous life.
Ask God to teach you to number your days and live wisely.

topics.title: Waiting on God
topics.summary: Waiting on God is not wasted time. He is good to those who wait for Him.

verses.reflection: Those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength.
The Lord is good to those who wait for Him.
Wait for the Lord and hope in His Word.
God's promises have an appointed time. Though it waits, it will come.
Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for Him.

topics.title: Heartbreak and breakups
topics.summary: God heals broken hearts and stays when others leave.

verses.reflection: God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
The Lord is near when your heart is broken.
Mountains may move, but God's kindness will not leave you.
When your heart fails, God is its strength.
God can do a new thing and make a way where there seems to be none.

topics.title: Contentment
topics.summary: Contentment is learned by trusting God with what we have.

verses.reflection: Jesus says store up treasure in heaven, because your heart follows your treasure.
Paul learned to be content in every situation.
Godliness with contentment is great gain.
With the Lord as your Shepherd, you have what you truly need.
A little with reverence for God is better than great wealth with trouble.

topics.title: Kindness
topics.summary: Treat others the way you want to be treated.

verses.reflection: Jesus' golden rule: treat others the way you want them to treat you.
Be kind and tenderhearted toward one another.
Do good to everyone whenever you have the chance.
Wear mercy and truth like a necklace; write them on your heart.
Kindness blesses the one who shows it.

topics.title: Turning back to God
topics.summary: God welcomes everyone who turns back to Him.

verses.reflection: Heaven rejoices when one person turns back to God.
Turn to God, and your sins will be wiped away and refreshing will come.
Return to the Lord, and He will have mercy and freely pardon.
God wants a changed heart, and He is gracious and merciful.
Godly sorrow leads to repentance and new life, without regret.

topics.title: God's faithfulness
topics.summary: God keeps His promises. His faithfulness never fails.

verses.reflection: God's mercies are new every morning. Great is His faithfulness.
God is the faithful God who keeps His covenant of love.
Hold on to hope, because the One who promised is faithful.
Even when we are faithless, He remains faithful.
God's faithfulness reaches to the skies.

topics.title: Sleep
topics.summary: You can rest because God watches over you and never sleeps.

verses.reflection: You can lie down in peace and sleep, because the Lord keeps you safe.
The One who watches over you never slumbers or sleeps.
When you lie down, you need not be afraid. Your sleep can be sweet.
David slept and woke again because the Lord held him up.
God gives sleep to those He loves.

topics.title: Stress and pressure
topics.summary: When life is too much, run to the Rock that is higher than you.

verses.reflection: Jesus offers rest and a light burden to the overloaded.
When your heart is overwhelmed, ask God to lead you to the Rock higher than you.
Pray about everything, and God's peace will guard you.
In distress David called to the Lord, and God heard.
When thoughts multiply, God's comfort brings delight.

topics.title: Rest
topics.summary: God built rest into life. Jesus gives rest to the soul.

verses.reflection: Jesus gives rest to all who come to Him.
Jesus told His busy disciples to come away and rest.
The Shepherd leads to green pastures and still waters, and restores the soul.
From the beginning, God gave His people a day of rest.
Tell your soul to return to its rest, because the Lord has been good.

topics.title: Bitterness
topics.summary: Bitterness grows like a root. God's grace can pull it out.

verses.reflection: Watch that a root of bitterness does not grow and cause trouble.
Put away all bitterness, anger, and malice.
Hatred stirs up trouble, but love covers many wrongs.
Do not repay insult with insult. Bless instead.
Bless those who hurt you. Do not curse them.

topics.title: Loving God
topics.summary: God invites us to love Him with all our heart, soul and strength.

verses.reflection: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
David's soul thirsted for God like a dry land thirsts for water.
In heaven or on earth, there is no one we need more than God.
"I will love You, O Lord, my strength." You can pray this too.
Loving God means keeping His commands, and they are not a burden.

topics.title: Sin
topics.summary: All have sinned, but God offers forgiveness and new life through Jesus.

verses.reflection: Everyone has sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
Sin separates people from God.
Sin brings death, but God gives eternal life in Jesus as a gift.
We should not pretend we have no sin. When we confess, God forgives.
David asked God for mercy and cleansing. You can pray the same.

topics.title: Mercy
topics.summary: God is rich in mercy and calls us to be merciful too.

verses.reflection: Jesus calls us to be merciful, as our Father is merciful.
The merciful will receive mercy.
The Lord is merciful, gracious, slow to anger, and full of mercy.
Because of God's mercy, we are not destroyed. His compassions never fail.
God is rich in mercy and made us alive with Christ.

topics.title: Why is there evil and suffering?
topics.summary: Scripture does not answer every question, but it shows God working for good and promises an end to evil.

verses.reflection: Jesus was honest: this world has trouble. But He has overcome it.
What people meant for evil, God used for good.
The writer could not understand until he came into God's presence.
We are called to overcome evil with good.
God promises a day with no more death, crying, or pain.

topics.title: Jesus will return
topics.summary: Jesus promised to come again, and His people wait with hope.

verses.reflection: Jesus promised to come again and take His people to be with Him.
The same Jesus who went up into heaven will come back.
No one knows the hour, so stay ready.
Believers wait for the blessed hope of Jesus' glorious appearing.
Jesus says, "Surely I come quickly." Christians answer, "Come, Lord Jesus."

topics.title: Why did Jesus die?
topics.summary: Jesus died for our sins, to bring us back to God.

verses.reflection: On the cross Jesus said, "It is finished." The work of saving us was complete.
He was wounded for our sins, and by His wounds we are healed.
Jesus carried our sins in His body on the cross.
Christ died for us while we were still sinners. That is God's love.
The message of the cross is the power of God to those being saved.

topics.title: The resurrection
topics.summary: Jesus rose from the dead, and that changes everything.

verses.reflection: The angel said, "He is not here: for he is risen."
Jesus had told His followers He would rise on the third day, and He did.
Christ is risen, the first of many who will rise.
Because Christ was raised, we can walk in a new life.
The resurrection gives us a living hope.

topics.title: Leaders and nations
topics.summary: God rules over nations. We are called to pray for leaders and live rightly.

verses.reflection: Pray for all people, including those in authority, so we may live in peace.
Even a king's heart is in the Lord's hand.
God is above every earthly authority.
Righteousness lifts a nation up.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord.
